messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Implemented Neon Pairs using the documented architecture, including deterministic board codes, validated snapshots, pause and resume, saved sizes and best scores, and the replay CLI.

**Offline game:** [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html) — opened directly from disk in the browser tests with no external resource requests.

**Verification:** `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` (16 passed), `npm run build`, and `npm run test:e2e` (8 passed). The replay command passed valid and invalid input checks.

The verified environment was Node.js 26.12.1, npm 11.20.0, Playwright 1.64.1, and Chromium 156.0.8078.4. Accessibility-tree captures are available for the [initial game](/work/test-results/game-plays-a-full-4x4-game-f5f2f-a-useful-accessibility-tree/initial-accessibility-tree.txt) and [completed game](/work/test-results/game-plays-a-full-4x4-game-f5f2f-a-useful-accessibility-tree/completed-accessibility-tree.txt). No screen reader was used; spoken output remains a user-acceptance check.
